description: This file defines the DataGroupHelper class used for managing data group, API, and screen permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for reading configuration from YAML files, inserting permission data into the database, and retrieving entity IDs by name.

classes.name: DataGroupHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing and inserting data group, API, and screen permission data into the database, providing read and write operations utilizing YAML configuration files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: readApiPermissions
methods.description: Reads API permission data from a YAML file and transforms it into Api objects.

methods.name: readDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Reads data group permission data from a YAML file and transforms it into DataGroup objects.

methods.name: readScreenPermissions
methods.description: Reads screen permission data from a YAML file and transforms it into Screen objects.

methods.name: insertApiPermissions
methods.description: Inserts API permissions into the database based on a YAML file.

methods.name: insertDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Inserts data group permissions into the database from a YAML file.

methods.name: insertScreenPermissions
methods.description: Inserts screen permissions into the database from a YAML file.

methods.name: getDataGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves a data group ID from the database based on its name.

methods.name: getScreenIdByModuleAndUrl
methods.description: Gets the screen ID given a module ID and URL.

methods.name: getModuleIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the module ID based on the module name, with caching.

methods.name: getUserRoleIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the user role ID based on the role name, with caching.

methods.name: addDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for a user role on a data group into the database.
